// Export authored constants only. Residents continue to be generated by native C# rules at runtime.
import fs from 'node:fs';import vm from 'node:vm';import{stripTypeScriptTypes}from'node:module';
import * as P from '../../../server/src/town/places.ts';import{TOWN_SIZES}from'../../../server/src/config.ts';
import {NEWCOMERS,LANDMARK_PLACE}from'../../../server/src/landmarks/town.ts';import{LANDMARK_DOORS,LANDMARK_LABEL}from'../../../shared/landmarks.ts';
import {LINES as OMNIBUS_LINES}from'../../../shared/omnibusLines.ts';
import {allLamps,ROUNDS as LAMP_ROUNDS,LAMPS_VERSION}from'../../../server/src/town/lamplighters.ts';
import {DUSK_START,DUSK_STAGGER_H,DUSK_SLOTS,DAWN_START,DAWN_LAST,DUSK_LAST}from'../../../server/src/town/lampround.ts';
import {MOORINGS,HULLS}from'../../../shared/smallBoats.ts';import {berthOf,LANDINGS}from'../../../server/src/rowing.ts';
import {doorKeepOut}from'../../../shared/hallPlan.ts';import{doorKeepOut as cathedralKeep}from'../../../shared/cathedralPlan.ts';import{PLAN as TOWNHALL}from'../../../shared/townhallPlan.ts';import{PLAN as VLEESHUIS}from'../../../shared/vleeshuisPlan.ts';import{PLAN as OOSTERSHUIS}from'../../../shared/oostershuisPlan.ts';import{PLAN as STEEN}from'../../../shared/steenPlan.ts';
import {FLIGHTS}from'../../../server/src/town/possessions.ts';
import {MILLS,manRuns}from'../../../shared/mills.ts';
const root=new URL('../../../',import.meta.url),read=path=>fs.readFileSync(new URL(path,root),'utf8');
const source=read('server/src/town/population.ts'),names=source.slice(source.indexOf('const MEN ='),source.indexOf('// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the generator'));
const context={};vm.createContext(context);vm.runInContext(stripTypeScriptTypes(names)+'\nthis.names={MEN,WOMEN,SURNAMES,TAKEN:[...TAKEN],DOGS,DOG_LOOKS};',context);
const g=read('server/src/town/garrison.ts'),gnames=g.slice(g.indexOf('const FIRST_FL'),g.indexOf('export interface Garrison'));vm.runInContext(stripTypeScriptTypes(gnames.replace('const TAKEN','const G_TAKEN'))+'\nthis.gnames={FIRST_FL,FIRST_WA,SUR_FL,SUR_WA,FROM_FL,FROM_WA,TAKEN:[...G_TAKEN]};',context);
const constants=Object.fromEntries(['HAUNTS','HAULS','MARKETS','PATROLS','PLACES','PLAY','SHOPS','STALLS','STATS','TAVERNS','TOWN_EMPLOYERS','NIGHT_GIVERS','TRADES'].map(key=>[key,P[key]]));
const back=read('server/src/town/backtown.ts'),backNames=back.slice(back.indexOf('const KROEGEN'),back.indexOf('export interface BackTown'));const bc={};vm.createContext(bc);vm.runInContext(stripTypeScriptTypes(backNames)+'\nthis.back={KROEGEN,MEN,WOMEN,SURNAMES,TAKEN:[...TAKEN]};',bc);
const possession=read('server/src/town/possessions.ts'),lanes=possession.slice(possession.indexOf('const LANES:'),possession.indexOf('function segDist'));const lc={CITY:JSON.parse(read('shared/city.json')),OMNIBUS_LINES};vm.createContext(lc);vm.runInContext(stripTypeScriptTypes(lanes)+'\nthis.lanes=LANES;',lc);
const standing=read('server/src/town/standing.ts'),st={PATROLS:P.PATROLS};vm.createContext(st);vm.runInContext(stripTypeScriptTypes(standing.slice(standing.indexOf('const FIRST ='),standing.indexOf('export interface Standing')).replace(/\bexport /g,''))+'\nthis.facts={FIRST,SUR,TAKEN:[...TAKEN],BEATS,ENTREPOT_ROUTE,LOCK_ROUTE,RIJNKAAI_NIGHT};',st);
const mills=read('server/src/town/mills.ts'),mi={};vm.createContext(mi);vm.runInContext(stripTypeScriptTypes(mills.slice(mills.indexOf('const FIRST ='),mills.indexOf('/** A mill as a town place')).replace(/\bexport /g,''))+'\nthis.facts={FIRST,SUR,TAKEN:[...TAKEN],MILL_PEOPLE};',mi);
const wall=read('server/src/town/wallfolk.ts'),wa={};vm.createContext(wa);vm.runInContext(stripTypeScriptTypes(wall.slice(wall.indexOf('export const WORKS'),wall.indexOf('/** The wall\'s people and places')).replace(/\bexport /g,''))+'\nthis.facts={FIRST_M,FIRST_F,SUR,TAKEN:[...TAKEN],DOGS,BOXES,WORKS,KITE};',wa);
const lively=read('server/src/town/lively.ts').replace(/^import[\s\S]*?from [^\r\n]+;\r?\n/gm,'').replace(/\bexport /g,''),li={INWORLD:JSON.parse(read('shared/inworld_houses.json'))};vm.createContext(li);vm.runInContext(stripTypeScriptTypes(lively)+'\nthis.facts={MEN,WOMEN,SURNAMES,TAKEN:[...TAKEN],ROUNDS,SISTERS,BEGUINES,TOURISTS,CHURCH_STALLS,CHURCH_BEGGARS,SIGHTS,CONVENT_AT,BEGUINES_AT,HOTEL_AT,LIVELY_TRADES,CART_TRADES:[...CART_TRADES],DOGCART_TRADES:[...DOGCART_TRADES]};',li);
const rowing=read('server/src/rowing.ts'),ro={};vm.createContext(ro);vm.runInContext(stripTypeScriptTypes(rowing.slice(rowing.indexOf('const LOOSE:'),rowing.indexOf('const r2 =')))+'\nthis.loose=LOOSE;',ro);
fs.writeFileSync(new URL('native-godot/services/data/native-population-facts.json',root),JSON.stringify({...constants,...context.names,garrison:context.gnames,back:bc.back,standing:st.facts,mills:{...mi.facts,MILLS,runs:Object.fromEntries(MILLS.map(m=>[m.id,manRuns(m)]))},wall:wa.facts,lively:li.facts,lamp:{ROUNDS:LAMP_ROUNDS,LAMPS_VERSION,DUSK_START,DUSK_STAGGER_H,DUSK_SLOTS,DAWN_START,DAWN_LAST,DUSK_LAST},row:{LOOSE:ro.loose.map(b=>({...b,berth:berthOf(b.flight)})),MOORINGS,HULLS,LANDINGS},possession:{DOOR_KEEP:[...[TOWNHALL,VLEESHUIS,OOSTERSHUIS,STEEN].flatMap(p=>doorKeepOut(p)),...cathedralKeep()],FLIGHTS},LANES:lc.lanes,LAMPS:allLamps(),TOWN_SIZES,NEWCOMERS,LANDMARK_PLACE,LANDMARK_DOORS,LANDMARK_LABEL}));console.log(JSON.stringify({places:P.PLACES.length,shops:P.SHOPS.length,trades:Object.keys(P.TRADES).length}));
